issues.description: The array-append helper method name differs between artifacts. In the template repository, ArrayHelpers defines a method named appendElement(T[] array, T element) (src/de/tum/cit/ase/ArrayHelpers.java). However, both the template Stock.addToStockIngredients implementation and the solution repository expect a method named addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) (calls appear in src/de/tum/cit/ase/Stock.java). The solution repository provides ArrayHelpers.addElementToArray(...). This naming mismatch (appendElement vs addElementToArray) causes a compilation error in the template and will block students from compiling and running the provided starter code.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the helper name consistent across the template and solution. Preferred fix: rename the method in the template repository from appendElement(T[] array, T element) to addElementToArray(T[] array, T element) and keep its implementation identical; this matches the existing calls in template/Solution Stock.addToStockIngredients and aligns with the reference solution. Alternative: change all call sites (Stock.addToStockIngredients) to call appendElement(...) instead, but the first option is recommended to match the reference implementation and avoid further confusion.
